I will apply the DAP and urea I received from our cooperative, though the supply was less than promised and I must make it stretch across all my plots. I will also spread cow manure on this field, as we have always kept livestock and manure improves the soil. I will plant barley seed saved from my own harvest, not the improved seed from the market, and my children and I will do all the ploughing, weeding, and harvesting ourselves with our oxen.
